summary: Distributed storage system providing S3-compatible object storage, file hosting, and Iceberg table integration, designed for massive horizontal scaling and O(1) disk access.
usecases: Scalable S3-compatible storage backend for cloud-native applications
Centralized file storage and distribution across Kubernetes clusters
Object storage for large-scale media, backup, and archival workloads
ideas: Add edge-node integration for geo-distributed, low-latency file access
Develop a native FUSE cache layer for hybrid cloud-local storage workflows
Extend API compatibility to include Google Cloud Storage and Azure Blob interfaces
